messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a weird one on prod: when I quick-switch between orgs in the console, the billing quotas panel sometimes shows the other org's usage for a few seconds. Repro rate ~1/20. :confused:
kevin: :eyes: do you have steps? UI or API?
sam: might be the cache key on the /quota endpoint. we changed tags last month for routing; maybe TTL+shared key combo.
maria: UI quick-switch -> dashboard -> quotas tab. sometimes the numbers flash to the previously viewed org, then correct. network tab shows single request to `/api/quotas?org_id=ORG_A` returning values for ORG_B for that request id.
anita: that sounds like header propagation / reverse proxy routing slip. which layer sits in front? edge LB -> nginx -> quota-service -> memcached.
kevin: nginx has anon caching rules for GET /api/quotas; cache key was recently simplified to `route|path|accept`. we removed `x-org-id` to increase cache hits. oops.
maria: oh no. so cache key now ignores tenant header. :facepalm:
sam: confirmed in logs: request-id 01F... shows cached hit served with `X-Org-Id: ORG_A` but payload `org_id: ORG_B`.
ida: tagging: we should treat `x-org-id` and session cookie as must-include in cache key. quick mitigation: set `Cache-Control: no-cache` on quota endpoint while we patch.
kevin: i'll push a config bump to set `no-cache` for `/api/quotas` and `/api/usage` in nginx. small canary to prod-1 first.
anita: also add a guard in quota-service: if cached response.org_id != request.org_id then log and drop cache hit. add telemetry counter `tenant_cache_mismatch`.
maria: can we also add an automated regression test for quick-switch UX? trivial: simulate two orgs, toggle, assert no cross-org values after fetch.
devex: i'll add a Cypress check in the console e2e suite. will stub backend responses.
sam: long-term: we should stop relying on opaque GET caching for tenant-scoped endpoints. Either route by tenant prefix or require Vary headers.
kevin: agree. proposal: revert cache key simplification, include `x-org-id` and `cookie.session` when present, and add explicit `Vary: X-Org-Id` header.
ida: i'll create PR for quota-service defensive check and telemetry. kevin — want help with nginx patch?
kevin: yes please, pair on the canary. I'll schedule a 15-min window.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — "Console quota cache leaking tenant data". Priority P2.
maria: tagging #incidents FYI — impact limited but sensitive.
anita: follow-up actions: 1) nginx no-cache rollout (10m) 2) service patch (1h deploy) 3) devex e2e test (today) 4) postmortem draft (tomorrow).
ida: logging note: please include request-id and org headers in mismatch logs so we can trace.
sam: also add a quick alert if `tenant_cache_mismatch` > 0 in prod for 5m.
maria: thanks all. i'll monitor and report if I see other endpoints behaving similarly. :pray:
kevin: pushing nginx canary now, will post deploy id.
ida: PR opened: github.com/redwood/quota-service/pull/458 — defensive cache check + telemetry.
devex: added cypress test branch: github.com/redwood/console/e2e/branches/quick-switch-tenant-guard.
sre-bot: Deploy to prod-1 succeeded: deploy-2026.3.21-ngx-cachepatch (canary). No errors in first 5m.
kevin: canary looks green, rolling to prod-2..prod-4.
anita: once fully rolled, let's re-enable normal caching with correct keys.
maria: confirmed UI looks stable for 30m. closing my local repro. thanks team.
kevin: postmortem: I'll start a short writeup — root cause = cache key simplification omitted tenant header. action: add code review checklist item for tenant-sensitive cacheable endpoints.
ida: noted. adding checklist item and a lint rule suggestion to flag caching config that references `x-org-id` omission.
maria: awesome. I'll add screenshots to the postmortem and mark affected customers (none reported yet).
kevin: great catch, maria. :thumbsup:
